Highlights

  • − Oh My Pi v18.16.0 removes PI_TOKENIZER_ACCURATE (all models now use native tokenizer), replaces Editor.prediction with Editor.predictions, and deprecates compaction utilities in favor of @oh-my-pi/snapcompact
  • Hermes Agent v0.22.6 rolls up ~776 PRs adding webapp served from gateway, /model reset, per-skill locks, opt-in OS-keychain vault storage, agent-picked ElevenLabs voices, pre_llm_call hook, and resumable downloads

Coding Agents & Assistants

Claude Code

  • Release: v2.1.317 fixes project and local MCP servers disconnecting after the first turn in desktop sessions, fixes auto mode failing on 403/422 from LLM gateways, fixes claude auth status exiting before slow token refresh saves, and fixes effortLevel setting ignored by pre-started sessions.
  • Release: Adds warnings for /schedule when cloud tasks get unrequested connectors, adds confirmation before web/shell tools send account email, adds onFailure: "block" for Agent SDK hook callbacks, and adds cost report API GET /v1/organizations/analytics/cost for admin gateways.
  • Hot issue: #18435: users report inability to switch between multiple Claude accounts in Desktop without signing out and losing context, requesting native profile switching like Slack workspaces. (230 comments, 987 👍; +10 since 2026-11-01)
  • Hot issue: #88391: users report prompt suggestions silently stopped appearing in Desktop on 2026-08-18 (regression in 2.1.229), with no error or local override since a server-side feature gate controls it. (regression; 18 comments, 18 👍; +3 since 2026-11-01)

OpenAI Codex

  • Hot issue: #58302: users report XLSX attachments stay pending with spinning send control on macOS desktop version 26.1027.30824, and the composer stops accepting typing until the app is restarted. (17 comments, 1 👍; +11 in the last 24h)

Pi

  • Release: v1.5.0 breaks tool argument validation: TypeBox features outside JSON Schema no longer apply, plain JSON Schema tools now get same coercion as TypeBox tools, and validation errors show pi-schema messages instead of TypeBox messages.
  • Release: Adds extension update changelogs on fresh launch, faster incremental streaming for large tool calls and code-heavy answers, custom self-update commands via PI_SELF_UPDATE_COMMAND, and GPT-6.1 Terra model support with 500K context via Codex.

Oh My Pi

  • Release: v18.16.0 removes PI_TOKENIZER_ACCURATE (every model now uses native tokenizer), changes buildExecutionFrame to set loader into bottomBorder directly, replaces Editor.prediction with Editor.predictions returning all predictions, and deprecates several compaction utilities in favor of @oh-my-pi/snapcompact.
  • Release: Fixes context estimates for models without known tokenizer (Gemini, Grok) to use o200k_base instead of 4 bytes/token, which undercounted by 11–48% on code sessions, and fixes estimates no longer charging for another model's thinking signatures when switching providers.

Hermes Agent

  • Release: v0.22.6 rolls up ~776 PRs since v0.22.5 including webapp served from gateway listener, /model reset to clear model pin without losing history, per-skill locks against autonomous writes, opt-in prepared compaction, hermes cron cancel with missed-run policy, /delegation choices saved across sessions, hermes migrate for Grok Bot and OpenBot users, opt-in OS-keychain vault key storage, agent-picked ElevenLabs voices, pre_llm_call hook, desktop group chat improvements, Telegram video notes, Slack emoji reactions in threads, and resumable downloads in package manager.

OpenAI Codex

  • Hot issue: #58530: A ChatGPT Plus subscriber asks OpenAI to preserve separate usage allowances for regular ChatGPT conversations and Codex, warning that reports of a shared limit starting in December could make the product less valuable for users who combine coding and everyday conversations. (17 comments, 21 👍; +32 in the last 24h)

Oh My Pi

  • Release: v18.15.0 replaces GroupedLineContext.isUrl with url. It fixes OpenAI remote compaction replaying backend-only internal_chat_message_metadata_passthrough metadata that Codex rejects, and fixes Codex conversation replay failing on unknown internal_chat_message_metadata_passthrough.content_token_count by omitting backend-internal response metadata from replayed input.
  • It also fixes service_tier: "ultrafast" being dropped for OpenAI-family models on custom providers, Google Vertex Workforce Identity Federation ADC token refresh hitting the wrong endpoint, Anthropic and rotating-token OAuth accounts being signed out on invalid_grant from background usage polls, and OpenAI-compatible models ignoring provider-reported context and output token limits.

Agent Deck

  • Release: v1.16.36 fixes the UI by reordering orphaned sub-sessions among top-level rows and starting global-search sessions through the resume builder. It also fixes session handling so a fresh Claude start’s boot reaches the parent as info and its token lasts until the first turn, makes launchesFresh an atomic.Bool to stop a concurrent-restart race, and changes update polling to run on every check_interval tick instead of every second one.
